title: Import from Odoo
description: Pull catalog, stock, stock operations, and users from the saved Odoo connection. Re-running updates the same records.

help.title: About the Odoo import
help.overview: Copies your catalog, stock and users from Odoo into this company, through the Odoo connection. Choose what to bring in, and try a dry run first.

sections.title: What you can bring in
items: Currencies, Categories, Products and variants, and Warehouses. Odoo's categories become your collections, and each product also goes into the matching platform category when one is found; you choose it yourself for the rest.
On-hand inventory, Stock movements and Internal transfers, as Odoo recorded them.
Users: Odoo's internal users are invited into your company and can sign in once they accept.
Running it again updates what it brought in before, without making copies.

sections.title: How to run it
items: Bring in products and warehouses before inventory and stock movements, so they can be matched.
Dry run only counts what would come in; nothing is saved.
The result shows how many were created, updated and skipped for each part. Anything that can't be matched is skipped.

durationWarning: A large catalog can take several minutes. Keep this page open until the import finishes.
stockOverwriteWarning: Re-running replaces warehouse on-hand quantity with Odoo's quantity. Sales recorded here since the last import are overwritten.
missingConnection: Save the Odoo server for this company before importing.
dryRunDescription: Authenticate and count records without writing.
